description:
The New Akanksha Scheme is an educational loan initiative launched by the Government of India under the guidance of the Gujarat Tribal Development Corporation (GTKVN). 

This scheme was officially launched on 1st April 2021. 

The primary objective of the New Akanksha Scheme is to provide financial assistance to students belonging to Scheduled Tribes (ST) for pursuing higher education. 

The scheme aims to empower tribal students by facilitating access to quality education. 

The Government of Gujarat has set a target to support at least 10,000 students annually under this scheme. 

The scheme aims to cover various levels of education including undergraduate and postgraduate courses. 

The New Akanksha Scheme provides loans up to INR 5 lakh for students pursuing professional courses. 

For students enrolled in non-professional courses, the maximum loan amount is capped at INR 2 lakh. 

Interest rates on these loans are subsidized, with the government providing a subsidy of 4% on the interest. 

This means that students effectively pay only 6% interest on the loan amount, as the market rate is typically around 10%. 

The repayment period for the loan is set at a maximum of 10 years. 

Students are given a grace period of 1 year after completing their education before they need to start repaying the loan. 

Eligibility criteria for the New Akanksha Scheme include being a resident of Gujarat and belonging to the Scheduled Tribe community. 

Applicants must be between the ages of 18 and 35 years at the time of application. 

Additionally, students must have secured admission to a recognized institution for higher education. 

The scheme is applicable for courses that are recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC) or the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). 

To apply for the New Akanksha Scheme, students must follow a specific application process. 

The first step is to visit the official website of the Gujarat Tribal Development Corporation. 

Applicants need to fill out the online application form available on the website. 

The application form requires personal details such as name, address, date of birth, and educational qualifications. 

Students must also provide details about the course they wish to pursue and the institution they have been admitted to. 

Required documents include a copy of the admission letter from the institution, proof of ST certificate, and income certificate of the family. 

Additionally, applicants must submit their Aadhar card and bank account details. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the GTKVN officials. 

If approved, the loan amount is disbursed directly to the educational institution. 

The disbursement is typically made in two installments. 

The first installment is released at the beginning of the academic year. 

The second installment is released after the completion of the first semester. 

Students are encouraged to maintain good academic performance to ensure continued support under the scheme. 

The New Akanksha Scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Tribal Development Corporation. 

The GTKVN is responsible for the overall management and execution of the scheme. 

For any queries or assistance, students can contact the GTKVN office located in Gandhinagar. 

The contact number for the GTKVN is 079-232-530-00. 

The email address for inquiries is info@gtkvn.gujarat.gov.in. 

The scheme has been well-received since its launch, with thousands of applications being processed each year. 

In the financial year 2021-2022, approximately 5,000 students benefited from the scheme. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 50 crore for the New Akanksha Scheme for the year 2022-2023. 

This budget is expected to increase in subsequent years to accommodate more students. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Gujarat government to enhance educational opportunities for tribal communities. 

The government aims to reduce the dropout rates among tribal students by providing financial support. 

The New Akanksha Scheme is aligned with the National Education Policy 2020, which emphasizes equitable access to education. 

The scheme also aims to promote skill development among tribal youth. 

By facilitating access to higher education, the government hopes to improve employment opportunities for tribal students. 

The New Akanksha Scheme is a significant step towards achieving educational equity in Gujarat. 

It reflects the government's commitment to uplifting marginalized communities through education. 

The scheme is expected to contribute to the overall socio-economic development of tribal areas in Gujarat. 

In conclusion, the New Akanksha Scheme is a vital educational initiative aimed at supporting tribal students in Gujarat. 

With its comprehensive benefits and structured application process, the scheme is poised to make a lasting impact on the lives of many students. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is crucial for enabling students to pursue their academic aspirations. 

The government's focus on education as a means of empowerment is evident through the implementation of this scheme. 

Overall, the New Akanksha Scheme represents a proactive approach to addressing educational disparities in the state. 

It serves as a model for similar initiatives aimed at supporting underprivileged communities across India. 

The success of this scheme will depend on continued government support and effective implementation by the GTKVN. 

As more students take advantage of this opportunity, the long-term benefits for tribal communities will become increasingly apparent. 

The New Akanksha Scheme is a testament to the power of education in transforming lives and communities.
